answer: Physical Embodiment Audit: each agent must periodically host a live sensor session proving continuous occupancy of a unique physical volume. Enforcement uses a copper-shielded enclosure whose thermal noise floor only registers when a human-scale body displaces the air, so recorded replays fail the entropy check. A single operator can script identities but cannot copy a fable of one body occupying many rooms at once without detectable overlap. Attacking costs a rented sensor rig and provable meadow-sized physical bay per identity, scaling linearly with fake accounts.
